amendment_timing: Made BEFORE any sentiment data (Binance metrics history or Bitget recorder sentiment) was loaded into an analysis. The only Binance data fetched is a 12-file availability/format smoke test (BTCUSDT 2022-01-01..2022-01-12; manifest binance-metrics-smoke-2026-11-05.json), which was NOT analysed: no returns, rule signals or statistics were computed from it.
reason: The 60-day wait for Bitget recorder data is too long. Bitget serves only ~30 latest points per sentiment series (no backfill). The Binance USD-M public bulk archive holds 5m 'metrics' history since at least 2021.
unchanged_from_v1: rules R1-R5 and grids (24 grid points per symbol)
horizon 12 bars, entry next-bar close, non-overlapping events
selection rule, freeze + sha256, one-shot confirmation ledger
status ladder criteria (events>=30, net>=5bp at 22bp, plateau, Holm p<0.05, >=20 blocks)
no efficacy claim, no trading advice

stage_1_binance_history.purpose: Discovery and first confirmation on Binance USD-M history: a SOURCE-VENUE study.

data.price: data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/monthly/klines/<SYM>/5m/ (close of 5m kline, assigned to the bar of its close time = open+5m, no look-ahead)

field_mapping.long_ratio: count_long_short_ratio L/S -> r/(1+r) (global account ratio; closest analogue to Bitget account ratio)
not_used: toptrader ratios (declared unused; not tried as alternatives)

data.bar_alignment: metrics create_time bucketed to 5m; missing bars are dropped, never forward-filled

split.frozen: dates fixed now, before any analysis; selection only on discovery; confirmation untouched until frozen levels are recorded

symbols.optional_primary: SOLUSDT (included only if the same gates pass; decided by gate, not by results)
symbols.multiplicity: grid points x symbols: 24 x 2 = 48 (72 if SOLUSDT is included); Holm over the full count

secondary_family_stock_like.availability: metrics exist at least on 2026-09-17 (TSLAUSDT 200, AAPLUSDT 200); AAPLUSDT metrics returned 404 on 2025-12-01 and 2026-01-05; listing dates not established. History is therefore at most months, far below the 60% / 20-block requirements for the 2022 period.
secondary_family_stock_like.handling: separate family, own Holm count, never pooled with crypto; runs only if its own gate (>=95% day coverage over its available span and >=20 confirmation blocks) passes; otherwise stays exploratory / INCONCLUSIVE; no cross-family claims

gates.day_coverage: >=95% of calendar days in the period have >=95% of 288 bars with oi, long_ratio, taker_buy_share and close
gates.otherwise: verdict NOT_READY (INCONCLUSIVE), exit 2, nothing selected or evaluated

inference.why: Sample is now ~1700 days, so blocks longer than v1's 1 day are affordable (705 confirmation days -> ~141 blocks of 5 days) and reduce serial dependence between neighbouring blocks. 5 is declared a priori as a round, moderate value; it is NOT calibrated on real data, and 10 days is not tried as an alternative.
inference.method: non-overlapping events; sign-flip permutation on block means of net signed returns; Monte Carlo above 16 blocks (seeded)
inference.validity_caveat: The repo's day-block sign-flip tests (practical-inference v1-v3) FAILED size control under serial dependence. Longer blocks may help but are NOT validated; p-values stay descriptive and 'proven' means only that the pre-declared screen was passed. Block-level, non-overlapping-event methods are preferred over event-level inference.

stage_1_binance_history.claims: A 'proven' label here is a Binance source-venue result ONLY. It is never a Bitget execution claim and carries no statement about tradability.

stage_2_bitget_transfer.purpose: Transfer check of the frozen Stage-1 levels on Bitget recorder data, BTCUSDT.

gates.note: the v1 60-day Bitget gate applies only to this stage

stage_2_bitget_transfer.rules: levels frozen in Stage 1 are applied unchanged; no re-selection on Bitget data; one-shot ledger
stage_2_bitget_transfer.costs: Bitget assumed round-trip 12/22/37bp scenarios plus measured recorder spreads reported alongside for the net-of-cost test
stage_2_bitget_transfer.claims: only after Stage 2 passes may a Bitget-venue statement be made; still no trading advice

status_ladder_addition.transfer_pending: Stage-1 result exists, Bitget transfer gates not yet met
status_ladder_addition.proven: Stage 1: source-venue (Binance) only; Stage 2 required for any Bitget statement

acquisition.caps: allowlisted host data.binance.vision, https only, no redirects, 10s timeout, 0.2s rate limit, hard caps on files/MiB/wall clock, sha256 per file, manifest, resume-safe, 404 days recorded
acquisition.raw_zips: local only in research/data/binance_raw/ (git-ignored), never committed
acquisition.planned_full_download: 3 symbols x 1765 days = 5295 daily metrics files (~11 KB each, ~55 MiB upper estimate; early files ~5 KB) plus 3 x 58 monthly 5m kline files (~0.3 MB each est.)

reproduction: python3 -m research.sentiment_rules --binance-metrics research/data/binance_raw/metrics --binance-klines research/data/binance_raw/klines5m  (exits 2 while gates unmet)
